author: kycrafft
body:
I always waste time sorting my hotbar. Here's usually how it ends up:
  1. Sword
  2. Bow
  3. Pickaxe
  4. Gapple (food if no gapple)
  5. Axe
  6. Wood
  7. Other block/wood
  8. Glass
  9. Water or special map item
Anything after my gapple is usually blocks, if I don't have an axe. Special or utility items and food tend to go in the 9th slot for me. 

So how does yours look?

replies.author: Yaky
replies.body:
1. Sword

2. Bow

3. Pick

4. Gapple

5. Food/blocks when 6/7 is filled

6/7. Blocks/slabs and chest for rushing

8. Blocks or water bucket if 9 is axe

9. Axe/Water/Blocks


I am pretty much the same except I count axes as my utilities since I can't hot key 5 really well and I like slabs and chests for sneaky monument breaking in walls/floor
